Summary
: The English translation of the Chaitanya Mangala by Locana Dasa Thakura (1520 A.D.) narrates the pastimes (activities) of Lord Caitanya including conversations between his mother and wife before His acceptance of Sannyasa. The Chaitanya-mangala represents a Sanskrit biography written as a narrative poem which can be sung in various ragas.
Alternative titles: Caitanyamaṅgala (चैतन्यमङ्गल) Caitanya-maṅgala (चैतन्य-मङ्गल), Chaitanyamangala, Chaitanyamangal, Caitanya, Mangal, Locana Dāsa Ṭhākura (लोचन दास ठाकुर).
